findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used.
findings.comment:
Observed the following are not smooth, easily cleanable surfaces: 

(1) Observed the newly installed coolers still have the protective coating (which is starting to peel off). The PIC began the process of removing the protective coating during the inspection. The coating must be completely removed to make a smooth, easily cleanable surface. 

(2) Observed there are several small holes in the wall surrounding the triple sink. The holes must be filled (ex. caulking) to make a smooth, easily cleanable surface.

Ensure that all surfaces are smooth and easily cleanable by the next routine inspection. 

4-101.11(B)-(E) Characteristics. Materials that are used in the construction of UTENSILS and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to FOOD and under normal use conditions shall be: (B) Durable, CORROSION-RESISTANT, and nonabsorbent; (C) Sufficient in weight and thickness to withstand repeated WAREWASHING; (D) Finished to have a SMOOTH, EASILY CLEANABLE surface; and (E) Resistant to pitting, chipping, crazing, scratching, scoring, distortion, and decomposition.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.comment:
No signed reporting agreements available for employees present. Inspector emailed document to PIC. Print, review with staff, and keep signed copies available for review during health inspections. Inspector will follow up at next scheduled event: 5/18/2023.
Ref. 2-103.11 (O) [Pf]

findings.title: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events
findings.comment:
No vomit/diarrhea clean up policy on file. Inspector emailed document to PIC. Print and keep available for reference. Inspector will follow up at next scheduled event: 5/18/2023.
Ref. 2-501.11 [Pf]

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment: Multiple employees observed to wash hands then turn faucet off without the use of a barrier (paper towel). Provided education and discussed with PIC. Review with all staff. Ref. 2-301.12 [P]

findings.title: All food employees have food handler training
findings.comment:
Employees without food handler certificates. Two employees need to complete the course and provide certificates. A third employee has completed the training but does not have a certificate (is on file at the school she works at). Ensure all employees have food handler certificates on file by the next routine inspection.
Ref. 410 ILCS 625 Sec. 3.07 [C]

findings.title: Hand washing sinks installed, located, accessible
Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.comment:
Observed two personal beverages sitting on a shelf above the open ice bin. Store personal beverages away from and below food for the public. Drinks were moved. 
750-160  Food shall be protected at all times from cross-contamination.

findings.title: Potentially hazardous foods properly thawed
findings.comment:
Observed hot dogs and brats thawing in sitting water or directly in the third sink. Thawing must be done in an approved manner: under refrigeration, under cool, running water, or as part of the cooking process. 
750-240 Potentially hazardous foods shall be properly thawed by one of the  following method. 1. Under refrigeration 41°F or below, 2. Under  potable running water 70°F or below or below with sufficient water velocity to agitate and float off loose food particles into the over-flow, 3. In microwave as part of the cooking process, 4. As part of the cooking process.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
No lid on the ice bin and then lid stored open. Ice bin should be covered with lid in between use. 
750-120(a) Food shall be protected at all times. Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Foods handled with minimal manual contact
findings.comment: 160: Observed bare hands being used to contact lemons for shake ups. Corrected. Gloves worn for remaining preparation.

findings.title: Hands washed, good hygienic practices (observed).
findings.comment: Observed hands being washed then clean hands used to turn off the faucet. Discussed using a barrier. Wash hands, dry hands, then use towel to turn off faucet. Touching faucet recontaminates clean hands.

findings.title: Toxic items labeled and used properly
findings.comment: 1290: Clorox bleach wipes were being used to wipe surfaces. Owner was told not to use wipes. He moved wipes to a box of take home items. Owner stated he would return to the normal bleach bucket and cloths.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 800: Observed the fan over the doorway (pest prevention) to be soiled. Clean the fan. Owner stated he has a new bladeless fan that he plans to install over the doorway.
